# Jóga seberozvoje — Kateřina Hlavičková

> Jóga seberozvoje (Yoga for Self-Development) is a somatic yoga, breathwork, and self-discovery platform based in Prague, Czech Republic, and available globally online. Founded by Kateřina Hlavičková.

## Core Philosophy & Mission
Jóga seberozvoje views yoga as a tool for self-knowledge, nervous system regulation, and returning to oneself—without performance pressure or force.

## Primary Offerings & Services
- **Ochutnávková lekce (Taster Session):** 75-minute individual 1:1 introductory session combining consultation, breathwork, gentle postures, and guided relaxation.
- **Kořeny (Roots - 1:1 Mentoring Program):** 8-week personalized 1:1 journey for grounding, clarity, and inner stability.
- **Rovnováha (Balance - Group Course):** Live guided group course focusing on stress regulation and mindful practice.
- **Pět minut ráno (Free Morning Practice):** Free 5-minute guided somatic audio practice & PDF breathing guide.
- **Workshops & Seasonal Events:** Specialized workshops in Prague and online.
